title: Cross-cohort reproducibility of human saphenous vein remodeling signatures and their directional alignment with occluded grafts: analysis code and result tables

creators.name: Tong, Siqi
creators.affiliation: Wuhan University of Science and Technology

description: Analysis code, locked gene sets, archived result tables, and reproduction evidence for the manuscript on cross-cohort reproducibility of the human saphenous vein ex vivo culture model. Five public GEO datasets from three research groups (two bulk RNA-seq culture cohorts, Visium and GeoMx spatial datasets, one occluded-graft cohort) were reanalysed under a locked analysis plan. Running Rscript run_reproduction_audit.R from the repository root downloads all inputs from GEO, hash-locks them, runs the full chain, executes 23 key-number and semantic checks, and compares every output byte-for-byte against the archived reference. Data files are downloaded from GEO at run time and are not redistributed.
